title: Quiz: Anchor Positioning

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in CSS?
questions.explanation: In CSS, /* */ marks a comment. Block comments use /* ... */.

questions.question: What does anchor positioning replace?
questions.correctAnswer: JavaScript that measures element positions for popovers

questions.question: True or False: Declarative anchoring handles placement and flipping in CSS.
What is the main purpose of the Anchor Positioning technique shown in this lesson?
questions.explanation: It exists to help you anchor positioning effectively.

questions.question: In CSS, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
